lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Commander, are you okay?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Other than what she told us, did Syuen say anything else?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How did Matis respond to the plan?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anis, calm down.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wow, Anis is full of questions today!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Sorry.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I must admit, I'm awfully curious myself, Master.
Syuen lied to Matis.
She said they are going to build new defensive walls for the Ark up on the surface.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That's absurd!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: They think they're off to do the right thing.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: When they find out the truth, they're in for one heck of a shock...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I must tell Matis the truth.
Don't do that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Commander!!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't tell me this is for their own good! It's lying to them, plain and simple!
Syuen hopes to keep the situation under wraps.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why would she want to do that?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If she didn't, Matis wouldn't be willing to go up to the surface.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So what?! That's their choice to make!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If they were to refuse, they'd have their memories wiped.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That's not 100% certain.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Just look at public opinion right now.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The people are in a furor. Syuen can't possibly turn a blind eye to that.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Good point.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: How sad...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Given the gravity of the situation, Enikk would be justified in carrying out a memory wipe

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: if it meant appeasing the public.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Nononono!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I refuse to accept that!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Feel however you want; it won't change anything.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The decision has been made, and Matis has to go.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I don't want to go to the surface!
